scripts.db:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --wait -d postgres redis
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down -v && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --wait -d postgres
scripts.extractor:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile extractor up -d --build extractor
scripts.dev: pnpm db:up && pnpm extractor:up && pnpm db:sync && turbo run dev --filter=@kichulbot/api --filter=@kichulbot/web --filter=@kichulbot/admin
